review_cost.rationale: A real round of changes before approving: 404 pattern, generated Route types replacing any, and the search race fix; all contained, no structural rework.

findings.issue: URL→input sync effect can clobber search text the user is still typing when a debounced navigation resolves
findings.suggestion: Only sync from qFromUrl when the input is not focused (or compare against navigation state) so in-flight keystrokes survive

findings.issue: Home-grown notFound flag in four loaders instead of the documented data("Not Found", { status: 404 }) + ErrorBoundary; missing resources serve HTTP 200
findings.suggestion: Throw data with status 404 and render a route ErrorBoundary/NotFound component; the framework then sets the response status and removes the per-route flag and meta guards

findings.issue: No generated Route types despite strict tsconfig with .react-router/types rootDirs; loaders and components are all any
findings.suggestion: Import Route.LoaderArgs/Route.ComponentProps from ./+types/<route> and type the shared card/entry interfaces through components

findings.issue: HashScroller duplicates ScrollRestoration's hash scrolling and uses a 0ms+100ms double-timer hack
findings.suggestion: Rely on ScrollRestoration (which scrolls to location.hash) and delete the component, or document why the retry is needed

findings.issue: Root ErrorBoundary renders raw error.message to users
findings.suggestion: Show a generic message and log the detail server-side

findings.issue: Re-implements cardsFromRefs dedup/exclusion loop to attach the hidden flag
findings.suggestion: Extend cardsFromRefs in data.server.ts to carry is_hidden instead of duplicating the loop

findings.issue: An unknown ?type= query filters to empty but leaves the select showing no matching option
findings.suggestion: Treat an unknown type/generation value like the not-found case or reset the control to the default option

summary: A cleanly layered, recognisably idiomatic React Router framework-mode app whose architecture I'd happily own. The blockers are contained: a home-grown notFound pattern where the framework's 404/error-boundary feature exists, generated route types configured but never used (everything is any), a search input race, and a redundant hand-rolled hash scroller. One round of review changes, not a structural rework.
